verdict.rationale: DGX B200 documentation shows command-line tools (nvidia-smi), NVIDIA Container Toolkit/Docker Engine support, and remote management via Redfish/IPMI/SNMP, all of which support headless, scriptable operation without a GUI. However, there is no explicit documentation of CI/CD pipeline integration, automation APIs, or headless orchestration examples tailored to CI workflows. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration guides, automation-specific API/SDK documentation, and independent evidence of headless CI usage in practice.
